items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I have a friend who just died, Veria? Wilson.

ctx.x: And he still had that little poke at the music. And so I didn't get back to Disneyland. I talked to that man, we were very close friends. And there was a good feeling between the man that booked us and me. But after that, I never reached him. I thought maybe he'd lost the job or something. This is what the press can do. They can hurt you very badly. You're

part of the press, you know that the power of the press -- for example, I have a friend who just died, Veria? Wilson. And he would talk about a certain musician, I won't name him, who was a bandleader, who has a son who takes care of the books. And every time he gets paid, there's money missing off his payroll.
And he says, I'd rather beat him with a sword in his hand than a pen.
